name: instance
description: Returns the singleton instance of QgProject. Use this to access the currently loaded project from anywhere in the code.

name: fileName
description: Returns the absolute file path of the current project file (.qgz or .qgs), or an empty string if no file is saved.

name: read
description: Reads the project file from the specified path (or the project's fileName if not provided). Returns True if successful.

name: write
description: Writes the project to the specified path (or the existing fileName if not provided). Returns True if successful.

name: addMapLayer
signature: addMapLayer(layer: QgMapLayer, addToLegend: bool = True, takeOwnership: bool = True) -> QgMapLayer
description: Adds a map layer to the project. If takeOwnership is True, the project manages the layer's memory.

name: removeMapLayer
description: Removes a layer from the project by layer instance or layer ID. The layer is deleted if takeOwnership was True.

name: mapLayersByName
description: Returns all map layers matching the given name. May return multiple layers with the same name.

name: mapLayers
description: Returns a dictionary of all map layers in the project, keyed by layer ID.

name: layerStore
description: Returns the internal layer store that manages all layers in the project.

name: setCrs
description: Sets the project's default coordinate reference system, used for new layers and map canvas.

name: crs
description: Returns the project's default coordinate reference system.

name: homePath
description: Returns the project's home directory path (typically where the .qgs/.qgz file is located) for resolving relative paths.

name: setTitle
description: Sets the project's title, displayed in window titles and metadata.

name: title
description: Returns the project's title, or an empty string if no title is set.

name: absoluteFilePath
description: Converts a relative path (relative to project home) to an absolute file path.
